definitions.explanation: Winning a championship in consecutive years or events. A major achievement in sports and competitions.

examples.japanese: そのチームは{3年|さんねん}{連続|れんぞく}で{連覇|れんぱ}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: That team achieved three consecutive championships.

examples.japanese: {連覇|れんぱ}の{記録|きろく}が{途切|とぎ}れた。
examples.english: The streak of consecutive championships was broken.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{世界選手権|せかいせんしゅけん}{2連覇|にれんぱ}を{目指|めざ}している。
examples.english: He's aiming for two consecutive world championship wins.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{連|れん} (consecutive, chain) + {覇|は} (supremacy, championship)

VERB FORM:
・{連覇|れんぱ}する (to win consecutive championships)
・{連覇|れんぱ}を{達成|たっせい}する (to achieve consecutive championships)

NUMBERED FORMS:
・{2連覇|にれんぱ} (two consecutive championships)
・{3連覇|さんれんぱ} (three consecutive championships)
・{V2|ブイツー} (2nd consecutive win - alternate casual form)
・{V3|ブイスリー} (3rd consecutive win)

RELATED TERMS:
・{連勝|れんしょう} (consecutive wins - games)
・{優勝|ゆうしょう} (championship)
・{制覇|せいは} (domination, conquest)
・{覇者|はしゃ} (champion)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
・Sports championships ({甲子園|こうしえん}, {プロ野球|やきゅう}, etc.)
・Sumo tournaments
・Olympic events
・Various competitions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{連覇|れんぱ}を{狙|ねら}う (to aim for consecutive championships)
・{連覇|れんぱ}がかかる (consecutive championship is at stake)
・{連覇|れんぱ}を{阻止|そし}する (to prevent consecutive championships)
・{史上初|しじょうはつ}の{連覇|れんぱ} (first consecutive championship in history)
